body.prompt: Vertical 9:16 realistic first-person POV smartphone photo looking down into an open old wooden bedroom drawer full of forgotten things (an old phone charger, papers, a comb), everything covered with a visible layer of grey dust. In the foreground a man's hand with light-brown skin holds up the GEODA deodorant stick from the product references, just taken out of the drawer and slightly dusty, toward the camera. The GEODA label (Desodorante, GEODA, 100% NATURAL, EFECTIVO Y SEGURO, 24h) faces the camera, upright and sharp, exactly like the product reference. Warm morning window light, dust particles floating in the light. No text.

Vertical 9:16 realistic smartphone photo of a bathroom mirror in a modest Colombian home, morning light. Taped to the lower corner of the mirror there is an old printed family photo with slightly faded 1990s colors, showing a smiling Colombian mother in her 40s holding a translucent white alum crystal stone in her hand. The mirror reflects only the tiled bathroom wall and a window, no person in the reflection. A toothbrush cup on the sink. No text, no logos.

Vertical 9:16 realistic first-person POV smartphone photo just stepping out of a hot shower in a Colombian apartment bathroom: the mirror above the white sink is completely fogged with steam, steam floating in the warm light, a grey towel on the rack. No person visible, nothing reflected in the fogged mirror. No text.

Vertical 9:16 realistic smartphone photo, bright Colombian apartment bathroom with soft morning window light and a little steam. Medium shot from the waist up, facing the camera: a 28-year-old Colombian man with light-brown skin, short dark hair and light stubble, wearing a plain white sleeveless undershirt, a grey towel over one shoulder, raises one arm and passes the GEODA deodorant stick from the product references (cap removed, the round white mineral stone on top, slightly wet) over his clean underarm, calm natural expression, lips closed. The GEODA label (Desodorante, GEODA, 100% NATURAL, EFECTIVO Y SEGURO, 24h) faces the camera, upright and sharp, exactly like the product reference. Not a close-up of the armpit. No text.

Vertical 9:16 realistic first-person POV smartphone photo looking down at my own chest: a man's hands with light-brown skin buttoning a light blue dress shirt over a white undershirt, standing in a tidy bedroom with soft morning light. No face visible. No text.

Vertical 9:16 realistic first-person POV smartphone photo standing inside a crowded articulated red city bus in Bogota during the morning rush hour, my own hand with light-brown skin and a light blue shirt cuff gripping the vertical metal pole in the foreground, commuters standing around with neutral faces, bright windows with city light. No logos, no text, no signs.

Vertical 9:16 realistic first-person POV smartphone photo in a bright Colombian office meeting room: my own arm in a light blue dress shirt raised high, writing with a black marker on a whiteboard covered with simple diagrams, boxes and arrows (no readable words), two coworkers seated at the table in the soft-focus background, attentive. No logos, no text.

Vertical 9:16 realistic smartphone photo, warm evening lamp light, 6 pm dusk through the window. The SAME man as the first reference (same face, same short dark hair and light stubble) arrives home to his Colombian apartment and is taking off his dark navy jacket at the entrance, wearing a light blue dress shirt underneath, relaxed and relieved expression with a calm smile, lips closed. Waist-up framing, face in the upper middle of the frame, plain wall behind. No text, no logos.

Vertical 9:16 realistic smartphone photo of a clean white bathroom sink counter in a Colombian apartment, soft morning light from a window, a small green plant and a folded white towel at the sides, the center of the counter in front of the faucet is empty and dry, tiled wall softly blurred behind. Eye-level framing with the counter surface in the lower third of the image. No people, no text, no products.

Vertical 9:16 realistic photo of a small bright Colombian shop: a clean white wooden wall shelf unit with three shelves, almost completely empty and minimal, soft daylight. The middle shelf is at mid-height of the frame, completely empty and clearly visible from the front at eye level. No products, no text, no logos, no price tags.

Thick shower steam drifts and swirls slowly in the warm light in front of the fogged mirror, the camera slowly moves toward the sink. Nothing appears in the mirror. Realistic handheld first-person POV smartphone video, natural light, subtle handheld camera movement.

The hands calmly button the light blue shirt, one button and then the next, moving down the shirt. Realistic handheld first-person POV smartphone video, natural light, subtle handheld camera movement.

The crowded bus moves through the city, everyone sways gently with the motion, the hand holds the pole firmly, light from the windows passes over the passengers. Nobody speaks, lips closed. Realistic handheld first-person POV smartphone video, natural light, subtle handheld camera movement.

The raised hand draws an arrow and a box on the whiteboard with the marker, arm stretched up; the two coworkers in the background nod slowly, lips closed. No readable words are written. Realistic handheld first-person POV smartphone video, natural light, subtle handheld camera movement.

The man takes off his dark jacket, lets his shoulders drop, exhales and gives a relieved, calm smile to the camera. He does not speak, lips stay closed. Realistic handheld smartphone video, warm evening light.

First-person POV: the hand lifts the GEODA stick a little out of the dusty drawer toward the camera and a soft puff of grey dust blows off it toward the camera and floats in the window light. The GEODA stick keeps exactly the same shape and label, the label stays facing the camera, the stick does not rotate. Realistic handheld smartphone video.

The camera slowly pushes in toward the old printed photo taped to the mirror, a man's hand with light-brown skin enters from the right and gently straightens the corner of the photo with one finger. The photo is a still printed picture: nothing inside the photo moves. Nobody appears in the mirror. Realistic handheld smartphone video, morning light.

The man calmly passes the GEODA stick over his underarm twice with slow strokes, relaxed, then lowers the stick a little. He does not speak, lips stay closed the whole time. The GEODA stick keeps exactly the same shape and label, the label stays facing the camera, the stick does not rotate. Realistic handheld smartphone video, soft morning light.

The man slips off his dark jacket from his shoulders, lets his shoulders drop and gives a relieved, calm closed-mouth smile to the camera, breathing out through his nose. He does not speak and never opens his mouth, lips stay closed the whole time. Realistic handheld smartphone video, warm evening light.

Vertical 9:16 realistic smartphone photo, warm evening lamp light, 6 pm dusk through the window. The SAME man as the first reference (same short dark hair, same light blue dress shirt and dark navy jacket) seen from behind at the entrance of his Colombian apartment, hanging his dark navy jacket on a wall coat hook next to the door, keys on a small table. His face is not visible (back to the camera). Full upper body in frame. No text, no logos.

The man hangs his jacket on the hook, lets his shoulders drop and stretches his neck with a relieved sigh, still with his back to the camera; his face is never shown. Realistic handheld smartphone video, warm evening light.
